headline: Bank Of America Announces Deal To Acquire Up To 49.9% Of Jio Financial's Jio Credit For Up To $1.9B; Initial Equity Interest Of 26.5%
Bank Of America Partners With Jio Financial In $1.9B India Deal
summary: Bank of America is set to acquire up to a 49.9% stake in Jio Credit, expanding its presence in India’s growing financial services market.
